title: Level 7: Testing and Quality Engineering
description: Build fast, deterministic, diagnostic confidence through risk-based unit, async, persistence, protocol, Android, UI, accessibility, visual, static, compatibility, and release checks.
plannedTopics: JUnit, purposeful test doubles, parameterized and property tests, coroutine virtual time, Flow, ViewModel, and use-case state evidence
Repository contracts, Room migrations, DataStore, MockWebServer, Robolectric, device fidelity, recreation, App Links, and notifications
Compose semantics, Espresso, idling resources, UI Automator, screenshots, screen matrices, accessibility, animation, flakiness, Orchestrator, and sharding
Android lint, Detekt, Ktlint, dependency analysis, Kover or JaCoCo, Sonar gates, ABI validation, and the Release Confidence Plan

project.title: Release Confidence Plan
project.summary: Create and implement a layered test strategy with explicit boundaries, critical journeys, test data, and flakiness policy.

theme.mapMood: A quality arena where each check protects a specific failure boundary.
